changes: Original fixed Entry/entry.html.twig extends original layout.html.twig/base.html.twig and includes original _tags/_reading_time. Truly rendered by Twig.js1.17.1 compatible Twig interpreter at build time, not hand-drawn HTML and not a claim to run Symfony/PHP. Translation uses original Chinese YAML; Symfony helpers and entry data are explicit local fixture functions.

Original fictional Chinese article rendered intact through entry.content. Read-only grant flags false: no account, editing, archive/star persistence, upload, comment/annotation service, export/share or external fetch. The original optional empty-annotation/origin/media branches are used, not photos removed from a real saved article.

Original desktop/mobile sidenav and collapsible theme menu use Materialize1.2.2 original components, original Stimulus3.2.2 controllers. Only required Materialize cash/component/global/Collapsible/Sidenav modules included. Original unused throttle/Underscore path removed, no algorithm rewritten.

Same Anime.js2.2.0 original official unminified source is used instead of Materialize embedded compiled copy; animation engine version/algorithm retained and no legacy compiler polyfill bundled. Original cash-dom1.3.5 embedded source preserved with complete matching MIT.

Original theme controller class changes and system matchMedia behavior retained; its cookie read/write replaced with instance-local preference. Original progress formula gets bounded0..100 and zero-height guard. Reduced-motion uses actual Materialize duration0; hidden pauses tracked timers/RAF and blocks user actions.

Original SCSS compiled by Sass1.93.2 and Materialize original SCSS; unneeded font-face and IcoMoon/social-image rules excluded. Unused Polymer preloader SCSS not compiled. Normalize7.0.0 and Waves0.7.6 CSS original full MIT retained. No CSS url()/font downloads.

Material font glyphs are explicitly replaced with approved Lucide-static0.468.0 original inline SVG, not claimed identical original glyph shapes. Exact mapping/hash/sourceSVG retained here. Original button/menu spacing and classes stay. Body font uses explicit system fallback.

Original empty mobile FAB (no granted actions) omitted; original actual mobile sidenav trigger stays. Add-tag/back/report/original/tag links disabled because no corresponding services/routes; no fake success. Original annotations/math/highlight/scroll-storage and full-site shortcut controllers not registered.

Owned exit unloads Stimulus controllers and destroys Materialize instances/overlays; cancels Anime and tracked tasks, disconnects observers/listeners, restores global M/cash and document theme; retained old anchors lose href.
Only runtime/docs/notices seven text files public; complete fixed originals/build/adapter/test source stays local, no ZIP upload claim.
